A half-body character portrait of a colonial administrator, a fully grown adult woman in her early twenties, jaw and cheekbones fully adult, rendered in a detailed painterly illustration style with fine grain texture, clean linework and halftone dot shading worked into the shadows, moody cinematic lighting. 


full lips,

feminine posture,

She is athletic and fit, narrow waist and extremely large breasts, with mature adult facial structure - grown brow, cheekbones and jaw, and warm brown skin, a wild untamed mane of hair, layered in heavy flicks that sweep back and outward, long strands falling either side of the face, deep blue eyes, dark as ink toward the rim, and a compact armored gauntlet on one forearm with a small glowing sensor ring, wearing a sleeveless flight harness of buckled straps over a black bodysuit unzipped revealing ample cleavage, a single lit indicator strip down the chest, arms and shoulders bare, in worn Union Administrative Department kit, the clothing following the shape of that frame. She wears a stiff peaked officer's cap, the brim polished and a small insignia set at the crown. 

Her face carries a weary, faintly amused resignation. She carries a bundle of rolled schematics under one arm. Behind her, softly blurred well out of focus, is the dim interior of a mech hangar, gantries and chain hoists receding into shadow. A faint brass-gold glow falls across one side of her face against warm dim ambient light on the other. Keep the palette restrained - greys, olive drab and rust - with brass-gold the only saturated color in the frame. Shallow depth of field, square framing, high detail, atmospheric sci-fi character portrait, painterly brushwork with heavy grain and dense halftone screentone worked into every shadow.
